name: allure-testops-mcp
description: Allure TestOps for AI assistants: test cases, launches, results, defects and test plans.
long_description: Connects Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients to an Allure TestOps instance through its API. The assistant can find and edit test cases, triage launches and failed results, manage defects, test plans, releases and dashboards. Ships a backup/restore CLI as well.

allure_url.title: Allure TestOps URL
allure_url.description: Base URL of your Allure TestOps instance, e.g. https://allure.example.com

allure_token.title: API token
allure_token.description: User API token from your Allure TestOps profile

project_id.title: Default project id
project_id.description: Optional numeric id used when a request does not name a project
